notes: Each entry diffs two heap snapshots of one page: an empty mounted list, then the same list after create(rows). Each snapshot follows two forced GCs; two mounts of 1,000 rows and their release run first.
Objects are matched by snapshot id. `js` lists the V8 objects new in the second snapshot, by node type and constructor name, with self sizes; the kinds sum to jsBytesPerRow.
codeBytesPerRow (compiled code, shapes, feedback) and nativeBytesPerRow (Blink nodes outside the V8 heap) are excluded from jsBytesPerRow.

`memo` attributes the new objects held by each field of a new Memo$1, and the arrays, closures and contexts directly inside them, each object once. Shared objects (an empty array, a comparer, the graph) are not new and do not appear.

Each bundle resolves both fixture imports to one core build (RANVIER_ROWS_SINGLE). rows-A: option code compiled out (RanvierRowsBaseline=true), createProjectionWith. rows-B: createProjectionWithOptions None. rows-C1: createProjectionWithOptions CreateFirst. rows-C2: createProjectionOnce None. rows-C3: createProjectionOnce CreateFirst (production).
